Educational Chicken Or The Egg

Sep 13, 2007 • Janice Cotcher

Poor teens ‘lag two years behind’
Poor children are as much as two years behind their peers in educational achievement by age 14 and heading for a “downward spiral”, a report says.
Last Updated: Wednesday, 12 September 2007, 11:51 GMT 12:51 UK

It really a vicious cycle: lack of education because of poverty; poverty because of lack of education. I know people want to throw money at the problem but I’d like to see what they plan to do with it.

I realize I post a lot of education stories from the UK but I see that is how our school system is heading. I admire the UK for recognizing they have a problem and trying to fix it.
